name: Aristarchus
overview: Aristarchus is portrayed in Scripture as a faithful companion and fellow laborer with the Apostle Paul, consistently present during Paul's missionary journeys and trials. Identified as a Macedonian from Thessalonica, he is mentioned traveling with Paul in Asia and enduring imprisonment alongside him, highlighting his steadfast commitment to the gospel. His presence in both Acts and Paul's letters underscores his integral role in the early church's mission and ministry.
